pages.title: Set up a lift
pages.text: Place an Elevator with a clear vertical shaft. Set its height in the hologram. Elevators work automatically and need no power supply.$(br2)Stand in the beam. Without multiple marked floors, Jump rises and Sneak descends.

pages.title: Add landing markers
pages.text: Place Level Markers at your landing heights, within two blocks horizontally of the elevator and inside its configured height. Floor naming is not available.$(br2)With multiple detected floors, Jump and Sneak select the next higher or lower floor. The beam hologram also offers clickable floor buttons.$(br2)Keep the shaft and each landing clear.
